data.name: HelpText
data.value:
Create a blank A4 PDF (Ctrl+N), open a PDF (Ctrl+O) or open a project (Ctrl+Shift+O). Select a thumbnail to navigate. Drag thumbnails or use Move Earlier and Move Later to reorder.
Find (Ctrl+F), drag across page text with the Select tool, then copy (Ctrl+C). Zoom with Ctrl++ / Ctrl+- and print with Ctrl+P.
Choose an overlay tool, then drag on the page. Select and drag an overlay to move it, or edit its properties and click Apply. Escape leaves the tool or cancels the current operation. Undo with Ctrl+Z and redo with Ctrl+Y.
Save Project (Ctrl+S) keeps the source and editable overlays in a .ppdf file. Save PDF As (Ctrl+Shift+S) creates a standard PDF with overlays applied. Source text remains in the PDF. Use overlays for additions and review. Secure redaction, editing existing PDF objects, and cryptographic signing are outside this release. The app displays PDF links and scripts as passive document content. Rewriting a signed PDF can invalidate signatures.
Use Export to Word or Export to Epub from the toolbar. Word defaults to editable text, tables and separate graphics. For editable scans, run Tools > OCR first.
